notes: Mage-VL-Cowork.litertlm of litert-community/Mage-VL-Cowork: microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork (Apache-2.0; a 4B computer-use agent: a 24-layer vision encoder and a Qwen3-4B text decoder) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 1920 x 1088 screenshot per request and writes the agent's next action. Published 2026-11-05 (Hub main 38bf428b at the read). Measured 2026-11-04 / 05 in the runs r10 and r3i's app (the published bytes).
quantization: text decoder (36 layers, Qwen3-4B) with INT4 weights (blockwise, 128 per block, OCTAV) and a 4,096-token KV cache, no activation type declared = FP16 on the GPU through an exact rotary-position path; INT8 embedding table; vision encoder and adapter with FP32 weights, FP32 activations declared for the GPU; one 1920 x 1088 screenshot per request (2,040 image tokens)
